title: Expand Your World
brandLine: Cincinnati Museum Center × NKU AI Native Studio

welcome.headline: Expand Your World.
welcome.body: Look closer at a physical object, follow your curiosity, and discover where it can take you next.

privacy.body: Camera images stay on your device. Anonymous interaction data and optional feedback may be recorded for prototype testing.

notice.question: What would you look for to spot an ancient relative of a starfish?

discover.title: Cincinnati was once under a tropical sea.
discover.text: This animal was related to starfish and lived in Cincinnati’s ancient sea roughly 450 million years ago.

notice.question: Why might a slab contain so many apparently “headless” trilobite bodies?

discover.title: They weren’t headless bodies after all.
discover.text: Trilobites grew by molting—crawling out of an old outer skeleton.
discover.uncertainty: While soft, they were especially vulnerable.

next.label: Ordovician Donut
next.direction: Continue to a mystery scientists are still exploring.

notice.question: What do you think caused the hole in this fossil?

discover.title: The mystery is real.
discover.text: This colony may have grown around another object—but the object left no trace.
discover.uncertainty: Scientists still do not know exactly what happened.

next.label: Keep Exploring
next.direction: See where your curiosity could take you next.

finale.title: Expand Your World
finale.headline: Curiosity is only the beginning.
finale.body: Your interactions can become a starting point for discovering more exhibits, artifacts and stories across Cincinnati Museum Center.
finale.closeNote: Prototype for Cincinnati Museum Center · AI Native Studio

about.headline: A digital layer that keeps the physical museum at the center.
about.intro: ExYoWo explores whether a lightweight digital interaction can encourage visitors to slow down, look more closely and continue exploring CMC.
about.section1Body: The object remains the focus. Technology should help visitors notice more, not pull their attention away.
about.section2Body: Visitor choices and engagement can help guide recommendations for what to explore next.
about.section3Body: The prototype is being shaped through observation, testing, visitor feedback and collaboration with Cincinnati Museum Center.
